title: 鐵路隧道疏散步道~Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels
focus: 隧道步道連續性照明與協助疏散~Tunnel-walkway continuity lighting and assisted evacuation
summary: 本課聚焦隧道步道連續性照明與協助疏散。從步道距離與協助時間建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把串行疏散時間帳與下車匯流區密度連成可驗證的介面，最後以受控演練證據安排整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。~This course studies tunnel-walkway continuity lighting and assisted evacuation. Start with walkway distance and assistance time to define physical or information boundaries, connect serial accounting of egress time with density in alighting merge areas as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through evidence planning for controlled exercises. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
history: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：1991 年一九八五年緊急整備指南於該年重印。；2015 年地下車站旅客流研究報告於該年出版。；2025 年臺灣鐵道車站概念設計指引函頒。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對隧道步道連續性照明與協助疏散而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用步道局部有效淨寬及協助需求路徑案例連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。~The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 1991: The rail-transit emergency guide originally published in nineteen eighty-five was reprinted. 2015: A study of underground-station passenger flow was published. 2025: Taiwan issued guidance for conceptual railway-station design. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For tunnel-walkway continuity lighting and assisted evacuation, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through local effective walkway width and route cases for assistance needs. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
example: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究步道距離與協助時間。原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。敏感度只改 speed=0.8 至 0.88 m/s，輸出變為 171.364 s；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究步道局部有效淨寬：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元把車門至安全出口分段記錄，將步行、跨越介面與等待協助分開而不使用單一最快步速。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。~Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate walkway distance and assistance time. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. For sensitivity, change only speed=0.8 to 0.88 m/s; the output becomes 171.364 s. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate local effective walkway width: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Segment the route from carriage door to safe exit, separating walking, interface crossing and assistance waits instead of using one fastest walking speed. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.

units.anchor: 步道距離與協助時間~Walkway distance and assistance time
units.title: 步道距離與協助時間~Walkway distance and assistance time
units.mechanism: 本單元把車門至安全出口分段記錄，將步行、跨越介面與等待協助分開而不使用單一最快步速。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。坡道、門扇與轉乘決策都可能造成停頓；對行動受限旅客而言，較遠但連續可達的路徑往往比短而不連續的路徑更可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。~Segment the route from carriage door to safe exit, separating walking, interface crossing and assistance waits instead of using one fastest walking speed. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone. Ramps, doors and transfer decisions can introduce pauses. For a mobility-limited traveller, a longer continuously accessible route can be more usable than a shorter route containing an inaccessible interruption. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted.
units.verify: 分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。以「步道距離與協助時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities. For walkway distance and assistance time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。回到「步道距離與協助時間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Trace the input chain for walkway distance and assistance time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑~The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
units.practice: 只把假想步速 speed 從 0.8 改成 0.88 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 185 變為 171.364 s。先說明「步道距離與協助時間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only assumed walking speed speed from 0.8 to 0.88 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 185 to 171.364 s. Explain the causal direction for walkway distance and assistance time, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 步道局部有效淨寬~Local effective walkway width
units.title: 步道局部有效淨寬~Local effective walkway width
units.mechanism: 本單元量測電纜箱、扶手與設備突出物造成的縮口，檢查上游寬步道是否仍受下游窄門控制。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。單位寬流率是情境參數，受方向、坡度與群體能力影響；多條通道的容量只有在下游沒有共同瓶頸時才能直接相加。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。~Measure restrictions from cable boxes, handrails and protruding equipment, checking whether a wide upstream walkway remains limited by a narrow downstream door. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance. Specific flow is scenario dependent and varies with direction, slope and user capability. Parallel passage capacities may be added only when they do not share a downstream bottleneck. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value.
units.verify: 量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。以「步道局部有效淨寬」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues. For local effective walkway width, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 以建築軸線寬度代替淨寬會高估容量，出口匯流也可能讓上游兩條通道互相阻塞。回到「步道局部有效淨寬」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Using structural width instead of clear width overstates capacity; merging exits can make two upstream passages obstruct each other. Trace the input chain for local effective walkway width. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加~Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
units.practice: 只把有效淨寬 width 從 2.4 改成 2.64 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2.64 變為 2.904 persons/s。先說明「步道局部有效淨寬」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only effective clear width width from 2.4 to 2.64 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2.64 to 2.904 persons/s. Explain the causal direction for local effective walkway width, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 高程轉換與橫坡~Elevation changes and cross-slope
units.title: 高程轉換與橫坡~Elevation changes and cross-slope
units.mechanism: 本單元比較車門下車處、聯絡通道與出口的高差，另列局部台階及坡道平台的連續性需求。坡度以高差除以水平長度定義，不能把斜面長度直接當分母。平均坡度之外還要檢查平台、橫坡與轉折，因為輪椅使用者在坡道終端需要轉向與停止的空間；符合一個幾何比值並不代表整條無障礙路徑連續可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。~Compare elevation changes at train exits, cross-passages and final exits, separately retaining local steps and continuity at ramp landings. Slope uses rise divided by horizontal run, not sloping surface length. Landings, cross-slope and transitions also matter because wheelchair users need space to turn and stop. Meeting one geometric ratio does not establish continuous usability of an accessible route. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Geometric teaching value, without asserting compliance with a jurisdictional ramp limit.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：高差 rise=0.45 m；水平長度 run=7.5 m。公式 y=rise/run*100，代入得 y=6 percent。邊界：幾何教學值，不宣告符合任何司法區的坡道上限。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: vertical rise rise=0.45 m; horizontal run run=7.5 m. Formula y=rise/run*100 gives y=6 percent. Boundary: Geometric teaching value, without asserting compliance with a jurisdictional ramp limit.
units.verify: 以同一高程基準量端點，再沿行走路徑抽測局部坡度、橫坡與平台平整度。以「高程轉換與橫坡」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Survey endpoints on one elevation datum, then sample local slope, cross-slope and landing level along the route. For elevation changes and cross-slope, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 兩端平均坡度合格仍可能隱藏短距離陡坡，排水沉陷又可能造成輪椅偏向。回到「高程轉換與橫坡」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~An acceptable endpoint average can hide a short steep segment, while drainage settlement can introduce a destabilizing cross-slope. Trace the input chain for elevation changes and cross-slope. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 只要坡道平均坡度適當就不用檢查平台與橫坡~An acceptable mean ramp slope removes the need to check landings and cross-slope.
units.practice: 只把水平長度 run 從 7.5 改成 8.25 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6 變為 5.45455 percent。先說明「高程轉換與橫坡」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only horizontal run run from 7.5 to 8.25 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 6 to 5.45455 percent. Explain the causal direction for elevation changes and cross-slope, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 串行疏散時間帳~Serial accounting of egress time
units.title: 串行疏散時間帳~Serial accounting of egress time
units.mechanism: 本單元在原創假想人數下建立時間帳，明列煙氣條件與可用安全時間沒有被此公式求解。疏散估算需把察覺反應、移動與出口服務分開。此處串接估算保守地把行走和排隊相加，實際兩者可重疊；火災分析還要比較可用安全時間、煙氣與群體差異，不能只由一個清空時間判定生命安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。~Build a timing account for an original assumed population, explicitly recording that smoke conditions and available safe time are not solved by the formula. Evacuation estimates separate recognition/response, movement and exit service. This serial estimate conservatively adds travel and queuing, which can overlap in reality. Fire assessment must also consider available safe time, smoke and population differences; one clearance time cannot establish life safety. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。公式 y=response+travel+people/(width*flow)，代入得 y=421.667 s。邊界：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s. Formula y=response+travel+people/(width*flow) gives y=421.667 s. Boundary: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated.
units.verify: 以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。以「串行疏散時間帳」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users. For serial accounting of egress time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 把預先知道演練的反應時間套到真實事件會低估延誤，忽略封閉出口又會高估容量。回到「串行疏散時間帳」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Using reaction times from announced drills understates real-event delay; ignoring an unavailable exit overstates capacity. Trace the input chain for serial accounting of egress time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全~A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety.
units.practice: 只把待疏散人數 people 從 600 改成 601 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 421.667 變為 422.111 s。先說明「串行疏散時間帳」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only evacuating population people from 600 to 601 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 421.667 to 422.111 s. Explain the causal direction for serial accounting of egress time, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 步道照度與暗區~Walkway illuminance and dark zones
units.title: 步道照度與暗區~Walkway illuminance and dark zones
units.mechanism: 本單元沿實際行走面布點量測，對照設備遮影與轉彎處的方向辨識而非只查燈具數量。平均照度由到達工作面的光通量除以面積估算，但光學分布決定暗點是否存在。煙氣、污損與電池老化可能同時降低可見性；指示方向、對比與旅客視力也會影響辨識，不能只用燈具是否亮著作為完成檢核。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。~Measure along the actual walking surface, examining equipment shadows and direction recognition at turns instead of merely counting luminaires. Mean illuminance divides useful luminous flux by area, but optical distribution determines dark spots. Smoke, dirt and battery ageing can reduce visibility together. Directional cues, contrast and eyesight affect recognition, so a lamp being on is not a complete verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：光通量 flux=2400 lm；利用係數 util=0.45 1；受照面積 area=24 m2。公式 y=flux*util/area，代入得 y=45 lx。邊界：均勻平均照度估算，未模擬煙氣散射或法定最低照度。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: luminous flux flux=2400 lm; utilization factor util=0.45 1; illuminated area area=24 m2. Formula y=flux*util/area gives y=45 lx. Boundary: Uniform mean-illuminance estimate without smoke scattering or statutory minimum values.
units.verify: 以網格量測平面照度並尋找最低點，對照電池放電前後與不同觀看方向。以「步道照度與暗區」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure illuminance on a grid, identify minima, and compare before/after battery discharge and different viewing directions. For walkway illuminance and dark zones, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 亮度集中在燈具下方可能留下暗區，指示牌反光也可降低遠距離的有效對比。回到「步道照度與暗區」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Light concentrated beneath fixtures leaves dark regions; sign glare can also reduce effective contrast at a distance. Trace the input chain for walkway illuminance and dark zones. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口~Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
units.practice: 只把光通量 flux 從 2400 改成 2640 lm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 45 變為 49.5 lx。先說明「步道照度與暗區」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only luminous flux flux from 2400 to 2640 lm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 45 to 49.5 lx. Explain the causal direction for walkway illuminance and dark zones, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.title: 緊急照明能量~Emergency-lighting energy
units.mechanism: 本單元以固定照明負載估算續航，再分別檢查啟動壓降與老化，使能量和電壓兩種限制都可見。電池續航以可用能量除以負載估算，容量不能只看安培小時而忽略電壓。溫度、老化、放電速率與截止電壓都影響可用比例；緊急供電還需檢查負載啟動尖峰，平均能量充足不代表瞬間電壓不會崩落。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。~Estimate duration at a fixed lighting load, then separately check startup sag and ageing so both energy and voltage limits remain visible. Battery duration divides usable energy by load, so ampere-hours alone are insufficient without voltage. Temperature, ageing, discharge rate and cutoff affect usable fraction. Emergency supply must also handle starting surges; sufficient average energy does not guarantee stable instantaneous voltage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：額定容量 capacity=80 Ah；標稱電壓 voltage=24 V；可用比例 fraction=0.7 1；固定負載 load=350 W。公式 y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load，代入得 y=3.84 h。邊界：定電壓定負載近似，未含電池非線性放電與溫度效應。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rated capacity capacity=80 Ah; nominal voltage voltage=24 V; usable fraction fraction=0.7 1; constant load load=350 W. Formula y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load gives y=3.84 h. Boundary: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded.
units.verify: 量測完整負載曲線與最低端電壓，分別核對連續能量及啟動瞬間壓降。以「緊急照明能量」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Measure the load profile and minimum terminal voltage, checking continuous energy and startup sag separately. For emergency-lighting energy, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 老化電池可能保有部分容量但內阻升高，啟動負載時掉壓使設備提早中止。回到「緊急照明能量」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~An aged battery may retain some capacity while internal resistance rises, causing early shutdown during a starting load. Trace the input chain for emergency-lighting energy. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 只要安培小時數相同任何兩種電池續航就一定相同~Equal ampere-hour ratings guarantee equal runtime for any two batteries.
units.practice: 只把固定負載 load 從 350 改成 385 W（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 3.84 變為 3.49091 h。先說明「緊急照明能量」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only constant load load from 350 to 385 W (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 3.84 to 3.49091 h. Explain the causal direction for emergency-lighting energy, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 下車匯流區密度~Density in alighting merge areas
units.title: 下車匯流區密度~Density in alighting merge areas
units.mechanism: 本單元將多車門匯入同一步道的區域細分，檢查平均全隧道人數是否掩蓋局部等待群聚。平均密度是人數除以可用面積，設備、柱體與危險邊緣應從面積中扣除。相同平均密度可以包含完全不同的局部群聚；門口、扶梯出口與轉角的局部高密度，常比整個大廳平均值更能解釋行走速度下降。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：靜態平均密度，不是擠壓力或個別人的安全風險模型。~Subdivide the area where several train exits merge into one walkway, checking whether a tunnel-wide average hides local waiting clusters. Mean density divides people by usable area after excluding equipment, columns and unsafe edges. The same average can conceal very different local clustering. High density at doors, escalator landings or corners often explains reduced walking speed better than the average across a large concourse. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Static mean density, not a crowd-pressure or individual-risk model.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：區內人數 people=180 persons；可站立面積 area=90 m2。公式 y=people/area，代入得 y=2 persons/m2。邊界：靜態平均密度，不是擠壓力或個別人的安全風險模型。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupants people=180 persons; usable standing area area=90 m2. Formula y=people/area gives y=2 persons/m2. Boundary: Static mean density, not a crowd-pressure or individual-risk model.
units.verify: 用網格分區計數比較平均與局部尖峰，記錄可用面積隨設備或圍籬變動的情況。以「下車匯流區密度」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Count occupants in spatial cells, compare mean and local peaks, and record changes in usable area from equipment or barriers. For density in alighting merge areas, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 將封閉區域算入面積會低估密度，遮蔽導致漏計又可能恰好發生在最擁擠的地方。回到「下車匯流區密度」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Including closed areas understates density; occlusion-related undercounting can be worst precisely where crowding is greatest. Trace the input chain for density in alighting merge areas. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 整個大廳平均密度低就能保證每個出口都不擁擠~A low concourse-average density guarantees that every exit is uncrowded.
units.practice: 只把可站立面積 area 從 90 改成 99 m2（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 2 變為 1.81818 persons/m2。先說明「下車匯流區密度」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only usable standing area area from 90 to 99 m2 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 2 to 1.81818 persons/m2. Explain the causal direction for density in alighting merge areas, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 出口服務積壓~Accumulation at exit service points
units.title: 出口服務積壓~Accumulation at exit service points
units.mechanism: 本單元記錄出口前的到達與通過人數，將不可立即離開的人保留在區內存量以維持守恆。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。平均服務能力若只略高於平均需求，瞬間車潮仍會形成等待；人群不能被無限壓縮，所以排隊長度會回堵上游樓梯或月台，改變原先假設的到達方式。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。~Record arrivals and passages at the exit, retaining people unable to leave immediately in internal occupancy to preserve conservation. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow. Even service capacity slightly above mean demand can be overwhelmed by a train-arrival pulse. People cannot be compressed indefinitely, so a growing queue can block upstream stairs or platforms and alter the assumed arrival process. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。公式 y=(arrival-service)*duration，代入得 y=72 persons。邊界：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Formula y=(arrival-service)*duration gives y=72 persons. Boundary: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.
units.verify: 同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。以「出口服務積壓」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. For accumulation at exit service points, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。回到「出口服務積壓」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Trace the input chain for accumulation at exit service points. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊~Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
units.practice: 只把觀察時間 duration 從 120 改成 132 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 72 變為 79.2 persons。先說明「出口服務積壓」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only observation duration duration from 120 to 132 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 72 to 79.2 persons. Explain the causal direction for accumulation at exit service points, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 協助需求路徑案例~Route cases for assistance needs
units.title: 協助需求路徑案例~Route cases for assistance needs
units.mechanism: 本單元以不同視覺、行動及溝通需求檢查路徑，將協助裝備與人員抵達時間列入情境。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Check routes for different vision, mobility and communication needs, including arrival times for assistance equipment and staff. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
units.verify: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「協助需求路徑案例」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For route cases for assistance needs, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「協助需求路徑案例」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for route cases for assistance needs. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險~One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
units.practice: 只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「協助需求路徑案例」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for route cases for assistance needs, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

units.anchor: 受控演練證據安排~Evidence planning for controlled exercises
units.title: 受控演練證據安排~Evidence planning for controlled exercises
units.mechanism: 本單元安排無擁擠的分段演練，保留場景初始狀態和觀察點，讓後續修正能使用相同證據比較。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。~Plan non-crowding segmented exercises, preserving initial conditions and observation points so later modifications can be compared using consistent evidence. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
units.model: 原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.
units.verify: 逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。以「受控演練證據安排」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。~Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns. For evidence planning for controlled exercises, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.
units.failure: 省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「受控演練證據安排」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。~Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for evidence planning for controlled exercises. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.
units.misconception: 所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果~All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
units.practice: 只把測試案例數 cases 從 120 改成 121 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 19 變為 19.1333 h。先說明「受控演練證據安排」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。~Change only test cases cases from 120 to 121 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 19 to 19.1333 h. Explain the causal direction for evidence planning for controlled exercises, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

facts: 教學假設：步道距離與協助時間採 distance=120 m；本課公式結果 185 s，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for walkway distance and assistance time: distance=120 m; this model gives 185 s, not a field rating.

教學假設：步道照度與暗區採 flux=2400 lm；本課公式結果 45 lx，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for walkway illuminance and dark zones: flux=2400 lm; this model gives 45 lx, not a field rating.
教學假設：緊急照明能量採 capacity=80 Ah；本課公式結果 3.84 h，非現場額定值。~Teaching assumption for emergency-lighting energy: capacity=80 Ah; this model gives 3.84 h, not a field rating.
